selection_explanation: First retain transcripts carrying VEP most_severe_consequence. Among them prefer MANE Select, then Ensembl canonical, then protein_coding, then lexicographically smallest versioned Ensembl transcript ID. This is a custom severity-first rule, not default VEP --pick.
missing_values: Empty value means absent/not applicable in the successfully queried source; never AF=0 by imputation. Presence status is in each source's status column.
vep_settings_location: VCF header lines ##VEP and ##VEP-command-line; user web export, VEP 116.2, GRCh38.
vep_fields: All VEP values come from the user web export. selected_mane_select contains MANE_Select or is empty; protein_position, amino_acids and codons preserve exported values. HGVS, SIFT and PolyPhen fields are not included because they are unavailable in this export.
rsid_source: Original VCF ID; Existing_variation is empty in the web export, so rsIDs are not replaced.
